description: This file defines the Statistics model class within the Opencart e-commerce framework. It provides methods for retrieving and updating statistical data stored in a database, specifically focusing on the 'statistics' table, including getting all statistics, fetching a specific value, and modifying values.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing statistical data, including retrieving all statistics and modifying individual statistic values.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all records from the 'statistics' table as an array of associative arrays.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value associated with a specific code from the 'statistics' table.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Increments the value associated with a given code in the 'statistics' table.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Decrements the value associated with a given code in the 'statistics' table.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Replaces the value for a given code in the 'statistics' table with a new value.
